hints.title: Path Length Parity Precheck
hints.text: Every path from top-left to bottom-right has length m + n - 1. If this length is odd, having equal numbers of 0s and 1s is impossible.

hints.title: Required Count of 1s
hints.text: The path must contain exactly (m + n - 1) // 2 ones.

hints.title: Bitset Reachability Propagation
hints.text: Track the set of achievable counts of 1s at cell (r, c) by shifting the combined union from top and left neighbors.

hints.title: Grid Path Parity Bitset Implementation

complexity.notes: Bitwise operations handle up to m + n <= 200 bits in constant words.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all combinations of paths takes exponential O(2^(m+n)) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary space using rolling bitset array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies bitset reachability state representation over grid transitions.
